feed.title: HardFOC PF1550 PMIC Driver
feed.subtitle: Portable C++20 driver for the NXP PF1550 PMIC family (3 bucks, 3 LDOs, Li-Ion charger, OTP) — used on Arduino Portenta H7 and the Synapse MCU domain. Includes the Portenta-H7-carrier profile, diagnostic snapshot, fault-severity classification and hf-core HAL handler integration.
